style: Cel-shaded 2D illustration in the style of a hand-painted animated feature. Thick, clean, confident ink outlines of consistent weight. Flat colour fills with soft two-tone cel shading — no airbrush gradients, no photorealism, no 3D render. Dramatic directional lighting with strong light-and-shadow separation: warm candle and torch light against cold blue-grey stone and night. Muted, desaturated Tudor palette — oxblood red, deep forest green, charcoal black, bone white, tarnished gold — with one warm light source per image carrying the emotion. Portrait/vertical composition, 900x1600, framed for a mobile screen. Keep the lower third of the frame visually calm and uncluttered: character sprites and a text card are composited over it at runtime. Historically grounded English Tudor period, 1536. Quiet, restrained, melancholic mood — never lurid or gory. No text, no lettering, no watermark, no signature.

scenes.scenes/greenwich-privy-chamber.png: Interior of a Tudor queen's privy bedchamber at Greenwich Palace, 1536. A carved oak four-poster bed with heavy embroidered crimson hangings, half-turned-down white linen sheets. A Flemish millefleur tapestry on the linenfold-panelled wall. A crowned white falcon badge — Anne Boleyn's device — mounted above the panelling. A leaded diamond-pane window through which the Thames and a moored royal barge are visible. Carved oak chest, rush matting on the floor, a pewter ewer and basin. Slanting May afternoon sunlight falling across the bed in long diamond patterns. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, the bed and window in the upper two thirds, floor open and simple below.
scenes.scenes/thames-wharf-night.png: A working timber wharf on the Thames at night, 1536. Weathered planked jetty, mooring posts wound with coiled rope, two small wherries and a rowing boat knocking against the piles, low river mist over black water. Across the river, the silhouette of the Tower of London and the White Tower, its torches scattering broken orange reflections on the current. A thin crescent moon behind cloud. Cold blue-black palette with a few warm points of firelight. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, the Tower silhouette on the horizon in the upper third, the jetty and dark water below.
scenes.scenes/seymour-wardrobe.png: A Tudor palace wardrobe room, 1536. Open travelling coffers bound in iron, folded velvet and damask gowns stacked in them, a French hood set on a wooden stand, dark gowns hanging from a pole along the wall. On a trestle table: an unrolled inventory list, a quill, an inkpot, a set of brass scales and a small heap of jewellery. A high, small window casting one hard shaft of daylight thick with dust. Plaster and timber walls, plain plank floor. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, hanging garments and coffers in the upper two thirds, the table edge low and uncluttered.
scenes.scenes/tower-constable-room.png: The small stone office of the Constable of the Tower of London, 1536. Cold damp ashlar walls faintly beaded with river moisture. A heavy oak trestle desk bearing sealed and unsealed letters, a stick of red wax, a candle burnt half down, a quill in a horn inkwell. A long ring of heavy iron keys hanging from an iron hook on the wall. A narrow arrow-slit window admitting one blade of grey daylight. A single joint stool, a low fire barely alive in a small grate. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, the wall of keys and window in the upper two thirds, the desk edge low in frame.
scenes.scenes/queens-lodging-tower.png: The Queen's Lodgings inside the inner ward of the Tower of London, 1536. A black-and-white chequerboard tiled floor. A stone fireplace with a modest fire. A canopied bed, smaller and plainer than a palace bed, with dark hangings. A tall iron candle-stand with several candles, and a small mullioned window looking out onto the dark inner ward and the mass of the White Tower beyond. Bare stone walls with a single faded tapestry. Every element deliberately colder, smaller and barer than a royal palace chamber — royal in form, prison in feeling. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, warm candlelight in the upper two thirds against cold blue stone.
scenes.scenes/lodging-door-corridor.png: A stone corridor outside the Queen's Lodgings in the Tower of London, at night, 1536. The frame is dominated by a heavy studded oak door, closed, with a thin warm line of candlelight leaking beneath it and through the gap at the jamb — the only warmth in the image. Worn stone flagstones, cold ashlar walls, an unlit iron sconce, and at the far end of the corridor a narrow window admitting pale moonlight. Deep shadow, strong contrast. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, the closed door filling the upper two thirds, the flagstones running toward the viewer below.
scenes.scenes/tower-green-dawn.png: Tower Green, the inner ward of the Tower of London, at dawn on a cold May morning, 1536. Frost still on the grass. A low temporary wooden platform of three or four steps stands on the green, strewn with fresh straw and draped in black cloth — bare and empty, with no block, no blade, no axe, no execution implements of any kind visible. The White Tower rises behind it, pale in the early light. A sparse, thin ring of onlookers rendered small, distant and faceless at the edges of the green. The Chapel of St Peter ad Vincula at the far side. Pale, colourless, level morning light; no drama in the sky. Vertical composition, the White Tower in the upper third, the empty platform mid-frame, open frosted grass below.
scenes.scenes/london-street-1559.png: A London street in January 1559, under snow. Timber-framed jettied houses lean in from both sides, their upper storeys almost meeting overhead; snow packed on the rooftops and trodden grey in the street. Painted cloths, tapestries and banners hung from the housefronts in celebration. Far down the street, seen small and in the distance, a coronation procession — mounted heralds, a cloth-of-gold canopy, standards — moving away from the Tower. Warm banner colours against cold grey-white winter light and blue snow shadow. The near foreground is empty of figures; the crowd reads only as small distant shapes lining the far street. Vertical composition, the leaning houses and banners framing the upper two thirds, empty snow in the near foreground below.

characters.anne: Anne Boleyn, Queen of England, 1536, in her early thirties. Slender build, long oval face, high cheekbones, dark almond-shaped eyes, a long neck, and a composed, intelligent, faintly wry expression. Dark brown hair parted at the centre and drawn back, visible at the front hairline beneath a black crescent-shaped French hood edged with pearls and set back on the head. At her throat, her signature pearl necklace with a gold letter 'B' pendant and three hanging pearls. A dark crimson-black Tudor velvet gown with a square neckline, a stiffened bodice, wide turned-back sleeves lined in black fur revealing embroidered undersleeves, and a long full skirt over a black kirtle. Full body, facing the viewer, standing straight, feet planted, arms hanging slightly away from the sides so that each arm reads as a clearly separated shape against the torso. Neutral, even lighting with no cast shadow on the ground. Isolated on a plain flat background for cutout.
characters.kingston: Sir William Kingston, Constable of the Tower of London, 1536, about sixty years old. Heavy-set and broad, a weathered, deeply lined face, close-cropped grey hair, a full grey beard and moustache. A tired, unreadable, professionally impassive expression — neither cruel nor kind, a man carrying out orders he has carried out for thirty years. A black flat cap. A dark charcoal knee-length gown with wide sleeves and a broad dark fur collar, worn over a brown doublet with a high neck, black hose, and square-toed leather shoes. A heavy ring of iron keys hanging at his belt, and a leather document pouch. Full body, facing the viewer, standing straight, feet planted, arms hanging slightly away from the sides so that each arm reads as a clearly separated shape against the torso. Neutral, even lighting with no cast shadow on the ground. Isolated on a plain flat background for cutout.
characters.thomas: Thomas Alder, a groom of the chamber in the household of Henry VIII, 1536, twenty-three years old. Lean and wiry, cropped brown hair, freckled cheeks, a plain, entirely forgettable open face; anxious and well-meaning rather than clever. Tudor royal livery: a knee-length coat in Tudor green and white, divided vertically in the two livery colours, with a crowned royal badge embroidered on the left breast; a plain linen shirt collar at the neck; green knee breeches, coarse undyed wool hose, and flat leather shoes. A folded cloth over one shoulder marking his household duties. Full body, facing the viewer, standing straight, feet planted, arms hanging slightly away from the sides so that each arm reads as a clearly separated shape against the torso. Neutral, even lighting with no cast shadow on the ground. Isolated on a plain flat background for cutout.
